1.Nf3 f6 2.e4 Nh6 3.d4 Nf7.strategy: The knight retreats to f7, where it guards e5 and d6 and supports a central ...e5 break. Black has spent three moves on a pawn move and a knight round trip, so White has the centre and the lead in space; the game is playable but uphill.
1.Nf3 f6 2.e4 Nh6 3.d4 Nf7.name: Zukertort Opening: Arctic Defence, Drunken Knight Variation
